pair.title: Pair this screen
pair.intro: Ask an admin of your business for a pairing code and enter it here. Codes work once and expire after 10 minutes.

errors.not_found: That code is wrong, used or expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.rate_limited: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes, then try again.

onsite.label: Join code
onsite.hint: Enter this code on your phone to join the line.

board.reconnecting: Reconnecting. The board may be a little behind.
board.error: Can't load the board right now. Retrying.

counter.unbound: This screen isn't assigned to a counter yet. Ask an admin to choose one under Screens.
